items.title: 14.9.1 Major air pollutants and their health effects (bare pollutants aur sehat par asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.9.1, printed page 315.

blocks.text: Particulate matter (PM) hawa mein latke hue nanhe particles hain, jaise dhool, mitti, soot (kalikh) aur dhuan, jin ka diameter 2.5 micrometre se 10.0 micrometre tak hota hai. In particles ko saans ke saath andar lene se airways (saans ki naliyon) mein inflammation (soojan) aur irritation (jalan) hoti hai, jis se asthma aur bronchitis jaisi bimariyan ho sakti hain.
ii) Nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) aur sulphur dioxide (SO₂)
NO₂ aur SO₂ ka thori der ka exposure respiratory system (saans ka system) mein jalan karta hai, jabke lambe arse ka exposure saans ki infection, asthma aur bronchitis ka khatra barha deta hai.

blocks.caption: Pollutants aur sehat
rows: saans ki naliyon mein soojan aur jalan

items: PM (2.5-10 micrometre): saans ki naliyon mein soojan aur jalan; asthma, bronchitis.
NO₂ aur SO₂: thori der mein jalan; lambe arse mein infections, asthma, bronchitis.
